items.title: The NVK driver for Linux was 18% slower than the GeForce Game Ready Driver in Cyberpunk 2077
items.summary: Enthusiasts conducted a direct technical performance comparison Cyberpunk 2077 running the Linux operating system using two...
items.content:
Login without a password Sign In Forgot your password? Forgot your username? News GAMES The NVK driver for Linux was 18% slower than the GeForce Game Ready Driver in Cyberpunk 2077 Maxim Boldson GAMES October 25 2026 Views: 1599

Enthusiasts conducted a direct technical performance comparison Cyberpunk 2077 Under the Linux operating system, using two different graphics packages. The benchmarks compared the official proprietary NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready Driver version 615.71 and a modified open-source NVK stack based on Mesa 26.3.0-devel. Tests were conducted at a resolution of 1920x1200 with low texture quality and RT Overdrive path tracing enabled. The benchmark configuration utilized DLSS Super Resolution upscaling algorithms with the Transformer Model preset in automatic mode, DLSS Ray Reconstruction, and DLSS frame generation. Frame GenerationA laptop with an Intel Core processor was used as the hardware base. Ultra 9 275HX, 31509 MB of RAM and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 mobile graphics card Laptop GPU with 8151 MB of video memory.

The built-in benchmark recorded a numeric difference in frame rate between the two software solutions. The official NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready Driver showed an average frame rate of 71 FPS, a minimum of 38 FPS, and a maximum peak of 131 FPS, with a total of 6656 rendered frames. The modified open-source NVK driver demonstrated an average frame rate of 58 FPS, a maximum of 74 FPS, and a total of 5832 rendered frames. Moreover, the open-source Mesa-based solution outperformed the proprietary package in terms of minimum frame rate, achieving 39 FPS versus the official package's 38 FPS.

A comparison of benchmarks revealed different peak and steady frame rates in a demanding graphics mode with path tracing. The proprietary package demonstrated higher average and maximum frame rates due to higher peak values, but had a lower minimum frame rate. The modified NVK driver performed worse in terms of average and maximum values, but recorded a higher minimum frame rate and provided a smaller spread of extreme values ​​during rendering.

items.title: ‘Cyberpunk 2077’ Rockets To Its Second-Highest Playercount Since Launch
Cyberpunk 2077 gets titan-sized crossover with dead EA FPS
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2077 has brought back a series long-since dead due to EA's stupidity.

Cyberpunk 2077 was already a peak gameplay experience, but it gets even better now that it’s somewhat revived a long-dead franchise.

Later this week, CD Projekt RED will return to Night City with a new update , centred around the newly released Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 .

While we don’t know what new content will be added, we’re excited nonetheless, though not as excited as we are for Cyberpunk 2 .

In the meantime, the best source of new Cyberpunk 2077 content, aside from CD Projekt Red itself, is NexusMods, and we’ve found a good one this week.

Titanfall BT-7274 (Quest and Companion) by whatmynickname and sdh0 is available on NexusMods right now, and it’s a must-play for fans of the Titanfall series.

As the name implies, it makes your Titanfall 2 companion BT-7274 an in-game NPC, and he’s a force to be reckoned with.

BT-7274 doesn’t join you right off the bat though. You’ll have to track him down through a new quest set in the Badlands.

Once you’ve found him, he can be summoned from the sky whenever you need some extra muscle. You can of course, pilot him yourself if you’d prefer.

It’s an impressive overhaul, but of course, like most of the mods we’ve been seeing nowadays, it comes with a catch. This has obviously been created with the help of AI tools. That’s not something we can get behind, unfortunately, so we won’t be using this mod ourselves, but for those who couldn’t care less, this looks like an explosive expansion worth trying for yourself.

READ NEXT: Cyberpunk 2077 players can now possess enemies in free mod, opening up a whole new play style

Seeing BT-7274 again got us thinking about the immense disappointment the Titanfall series turned out to be.

That initial first release was unlike anything we’d seen before and the follow-up was pure magic. Respawn found a great balance between a heartfelt single-player campaign and a consistently fun multiplayer; sequels were all but inevitable.

Unfortunately, for whatever reason, we’ve not heard a peep about new Titanfall games since. The series somewhat lives on through APEX Legends , but it’s nowhere near the same thing.

items.title: Latest Cyberpunk 2077 Update Quietly Adds Witcher 3 Items
items.summary: The Witcher 3 has made its way into Cyberpunk 2077 with new cosmetic items to equip and two melee weapons to wield, inspired by the legendary RPG.
items.content:
Add DualShockers on Google Add as Preferred Source By Lauren Sayles Published Oct 23, 2026, 10:47 AM EDT Lauren has experience in the gaming and esports space, writing news, guides, features, reviews, lists, conducting interviews, and more. Before joining the team at DualShockers, Lauren was a Features Writer at Adventure Gamers, a Guides Writer at Gameranx, as well as contributing as a News Writer at PCInvasion and Daily Esports. She also founded GameScout and holds a History degree. Sign in to your DualShockers account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Just when you thought CD Projekt RED was done with Cyberpunk 2077 updates, the developers revealed a surprise content drop. Update 2.5 is inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, the Netflix-exclusive series set in Night City, and it arrived just in time for the debut of Season 2 of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.

The announcement artwork showed V back-to-back with the anime character, Weak Kingsley, from Cyberpunk Edgerunners, before a REDstreams broadcast revealed more details before the update went live.

CD Projekt Red has announced that Cyberpunk 2077 has sold over forty million copies since launch, proving it bounced back from its botched debut.

CD Projekt RED has secretly released The Witcher 3 items in Cyberpunk 2077 as part of Update 2.5. If you wanted a taste of The Witcher 3 in Night City (if you didn’t have a mod installed for it already), the official items subtly bring the two worlds together.

Cyberpunk 2077 already has numerous The Witcher 3 Easter eggs in the base game and Phantom Liberty DLC. The latest additions are two new melee weapons for you to try out on your foes, and clothing based on the game.

Just like the update mainly celebrating Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2, CD Projekt RED recently launched The Witcher 3 Remastered, so it’s perhaps a fitting time to bring these items to Cyberpunk 2077.

Thanks to SynthPotato on X, weapons and cosmetics from The Witcher 3 have been located in Cyberpunk 2077. All the items discovered so far relating to The Witcher 3 are a small knife known as a Boar Carver, an impressive Sihil Sword, The Professor's Spectacles, which is a mask in The Witcher 3’s Hearts of Stone expansion, and the Ursine Jacket and Pants that are inspired by the Bear School gear in The Witcher 3.

According to SynthPotato, you can obtain these items for yourself by visiting V’s apartment after Arianne contacts you about a gift via text. You can then equip the cosmetics and weapons and tear up the city in The Witcher 3 style.

Cyberpunk 2077 already has numerous The Witcher 3 Easter Eggs in the base game and Phantom Liberty DLC. The latest additions are two new melee weapons for you to try out on your foes, and clothing based on the game.

The arrival of a new clothing collection was outlined in the Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 patch notes, featuring five new outfit sets that can be purchased from certain vendors. This includes Maxiwear (available in Heywood, Arroyo, and Little China), Jinguji (City Center), NetWatch (Kabuki and Japantown), IconAmerica (Pacifica, Badlands, and Northside), and The NUS Infiltrator clothing (Kabuki and Japantown).

However, nothing was mentioned regarding The Witcher 3 collaboration items. Some content is best discovered out in the world and The Witcher 3 cosmetics and weapons are one of them.

Elsewhere in Update 2.5 is the introduction of a new side quest known as Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Also, there’s a fresh Double Trouble perk that brings a new playstyle that allows you to dual-wield pistols and revolvers from the Power category. New Photo Mode poses allow you to look your best while taking advantage of the new dual-wielding capabilities, among a range of bug fixes and quality-of-life updates.

Only time will tell if the Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 will really be the last, but fans will undoubtedly be hoping there are more secrets to come.

A Cyberpunk 2077 movie is in the works at Paramount Pictures, and CD Projekt RED has already stated that it doesn’t want the film to be an adaptation of the game. Whether or not more updates are released, there’s more Night City action to come.

(In)famous video game director Hideo Kojima confirmed on Monday that he performed in the new original net anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 . The director said he is reprising his Cyberpunk 2077 character Hideyoshi Oshima, a braindance producer, in a cameo appearance in the new anime. Kojima also posted a handful of photos of his voice recording session: Image via x.com © 2026 CD PROJEKT RED S.A. Kojima made a cameo appearance in CD PROJEKT RED 's 2020 cyberpunk video game Cyberpunk 2077 as Hideyoshi Oshima. The video game itself draws inspiration from the Cyberpunk tabletop role-playing game series created by Mike Pondsmith in 1988. The tabletop game has seen several editions, including Cyberpunk 2013 , Cyberpunk 2020 , Cyberpunk V3.0 , and the latest edition Cyberpunk Red .

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is the sequel to the first Cyberpunk: Edgerunners anime , which Studio Trigger produced based on CD PROJEKT RED 's Cyberpunk 2077 game. The first series premiered on Netflix in September 2022.

The Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime premiered on October 20 on Netflix .

items.title: Is Cyberpunk 2077 Patch 2.5 Worth Returning to Night City For?
items.content:
CD Projekt Red shocked everyone when it announced that a major new Cyberpunk 2077 update would be dropping around the same time as the Edgerunners 2 anime.

While I imagine some fans might have expected a small surprise to coincide with the show, the scale of Patch 2.5 is pretty crazy — it's far bigger than it ever needed to be.

I ain't complaining, though. Regular readers will know that I'll take an excuse to revisit Night City.

But is Patch 2.5 worth coming back for? That's the question I'll attempt to answer in this Hands On article, because when the release schedule's as manic as it is right now, not everyone will have the time to prioritise older games.

2.5 features not one, but two new gigs to run through. And they're certainly not the kind of throwaway jobs that you might expect from a free update.

V's voice actors have been brought back for both of these missions; the stories aren't just a mishmash of reused lines and text-based exposition.

The first of these gigs, titled Clampdown, is the best. It ties directly into Edgerunners 2 by having V work with one of the new season's main characters, King.

Sadly, you don't get to see the big guy in action, but he talks to you throughout the mission via comms. It's a high risk job where V has to break King's buddy out of jail, and it takes place in Night City's big prison complex, which isn't utilised anywhere else in the game.

It's a solid 20 to 30 minute gig, well-paced with a mix of punchy dialogue and cop-blasting action. Plus, you get some really cool-looking clothes out of it, as well as a powerful new gun.

The second gig's more drawn out and ultimately more forgettable, but it's still pretty interesting. It takes V on a tour of Night City, as our favourite merc tries to track down a missing hacker who's obsessed with rebelling against the powers that be.

We get to learn a little more about the city itself, and what its founder, Richard Night, had in store for it before his untimely death. It's one for the lore-heads.

Are either of these gigs enough to pull you back to Cyberpunk 2077, though? Eh, maybe, maybe not. They're worth playing through, for sure — especially if you plan on watching Edgerunners 2 — but they're probably not going to prompt an entire new playthrough.

There's something else that might inspire a new playthrough, however, and that's the introduction of dual wielding.

A new perk on the 'Cool' skill tree, Double Trouble — which can be unlocked fairly early — lets you equip two power-type pistols or revolvers at the same time. It's basically a totally new combat style.

items.title: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
items.summary: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now, with content inspired by the second installment of the hit anime series now streaming on Netflix
items.content:
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” premiered on Netflix on October 20, bringing a whole new cast of characters to Night City for a dark, gritty ride. And now we’re bringing a little piece of that story into Cyberpunk 2077 , too! The free Edgerunners 2 Update is here, with content inspired by the anime, new ways to fight, more customization options, and plenty of other additions.

We’ve got a lot to cover, so let’s get into it. And don’t worry if you haven’t watched the new anime yet — no “Edgerunners 2” spoilers ahead!

One of the things we love about Night City is that there’s always another story unfolding somewhere. V may be central to the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , but they’re hardly the only merc in town, fighting to survive and make a name for themselves on those neon-soaked streets. Every fixer has clients, every crew has gigs to take care of, every Night City merc has their story — and sometimes, those stories collide in unexpected ways.

That’s exactly what happens in the brand-new quest introduced with the “Edgerunners 2” Update. What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley, a famed Night City merc and one of the main characters of “Edgerunners 2.” We won’t spoil what happens, but during the course of this mission, V has a chance to assist Weak and his crew during a risky gig that takes place in a brand-new location: Night City Prison.

The new “Edgerunners 2” gig is more than a chance to encounter characters from the anime in the game — it serves as a prequel to the events of the series. So, play the quest before watching the anime, and you’ll have a little extra context going into Episode 1. Already seen the show? Then with this gig, you’ll get to revisit part of Weak’s story with a broader perspective of him and his crew.

And there’s even more forEdgerunnersfans in this update. For starters, you can find and equip Weak’s full outfit — vest, glasses, coat, pants, the works — and get your hands on his signature revolver, Coronation. We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.” So if you’re planning to spend a few more hours cruising around Night City after watching the show, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.

What’s better than blasting your way through a warehouse full of gangoons with a revolver, dealing one headshot after another? Doing it with two revolvers, obviously.

That’s right — dual wielding is here! With the Edgerunners 2 Update, you can raise hell with a pistol or revolver in each hand. That’s a whole new vibe — and a whole new level of awesome.

But dual wielding isn’t just about looking cool. It brings a new playstyle and a fresh way to approach combat — in fact, it’s one of the most significant gameplay additions to the game’s combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives. So if you’ve been looking for an excuse to shake up your fighting style, this might just be it.

Cyberware enhances your stats and abilities — but what if it could take your style to the next level, too? That’s where glamdocs come in. These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from. Fancy a new look for your chrome? Pay them a visit at one (or all) of the five locations across Night City and see what catches your eye.

In a city that lives and dies by appearances, V really can’t afford to pass up any opportunity to shake up their look. On top of cyberware customization, we’ve also added 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets to give your V the best chance of standing out, even in Night City.

We know how creative the Cyberpunk 2077 community can be, and we’re always curious to see what players come up with. That’s why we’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.

The update adds a Mods panel where you can browse and install supported community-created content directly in the game. It’s a new way to experiment with your experience, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it develops as more mods become available and receive support over time!

We’ve covered some of the bigger additions, but there’s still plenty to find in the Edgerunners 2 Update.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.content:
To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.title: It’s All About You! — Never Fade Away

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
